content_sections.heading: About MbPA
content_sections.text: Mumbai Port Authority is a Major Port Authority based in Mumbai. This recruitment notice is issued by its General Administration Department, Port House, 2nd floor, S.V. Marg, Ballard Estate, Mumbai - 400 001, and is addressed to the Chairpersons of the Major Port Authorities. Applications are received through the Online Application Portal of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice fills one post, which will be vacant with effect from 9 May 2027. Annexure I (the eligibility table for the post) shows 8 posts of Sr. Dy. Chief Medical Officer in all. As per its remarks, one post each is operated in the faculties of (i) Medicine (General Medicine or Pediatrics or Cardiology), (ii) Surgery (General Surgery or ENT or Ophthalmology or Orthopedic), (iii) Obst & Gynec, (iv) Pathology and Bacteriology, (v) Anaesthesia and (vi) Radiology, and two posts would be for administration of the hospital department. The Chairman may at any time change the faculty/function in which the post is to be operated, considering the hospital requirements.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Annexure I states that the educational qualifications prescribed for direct recruits will apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation, while the age and the experience prescribed for direct recruits will not. Under Annexure I, the following officers are eligible for absorption: Officers holding analogous posts, or holding the post of Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) and equivalent Specialist posts in the Medical Deptt. in the scale of pay of Rs.13000-18250 with 3 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust; or Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) and equivalent Specialist posts in the Medical Deptt. with 2 years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of pay of Rs.10750-16750 and Rs.13000-18250 in the Specialist cadre of the Medical Deptt. in a Major Port Trust. Annexure I gives the method of recruitment as absorption through composite method, failing which by deputation from other Government organisations, and failing both by direct recruitment. For deputation, it lists officers holding analogous posts or posts of Dy. Chief Medical Officer (Specialist) and equivalent Specialist posts in the scale of pay of Rs.13000-18250 in the Medical Deptt. in a Govt./Semi Govt./PSUs or Autonomous Bodies with 3 years regular service in the grade. The present notice invites applications only from officers of Major Ports for absorption. Annexure I gives an upper age limit of 45 years for direct recruitment, and states that the age prescribed for direct recruits will not apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation. As per the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways' circular No.A-29018/4/2081/PE-I dated 11.8.2021, the crucial date for determining eligibility criteria is 9 May 2027. The selection is by merit, for which the overall grading in the APARs should not be below "Very Good". Annexure I states the same benchmark for the overall grading in the ACRs. Candidates are selected by the Services Selection Committee. The notice does not mention a written test. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification: (i) MBBS degree from a recognised university; (ii) A post graduate medical degree in the specified speciality from a recognised university
rows.experience: (iii) Post qualification experience of 10 years in a hospital, in the relevant field of specialisation

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The scale column of Annexure I prints the scale of pay of the post as Rs.16000-400-20800. The post is a Class-I Selection post. The period of probation is shown as N.A. in Annexure I. The post is filled by absorption through composite method. The notice does not mention allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MbPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit the application through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in, between 30 November 2026 and 29 December 2026. No application submitted other than through OAP will be accepted. Submit the hard copy of the application form uploaded in OAP, along with the requisite documents, to your administrative Port for onward forwarding to MbPA. The administrative Port forwards the application superscribed "Application for the post of Sr. Deputy Chief Medical Officer (Administration) in Mumbai Port Authority" on or before 13 January 2027. The Port encloses all relevant documents at one time; piecemeal or part forwarding will not be considered. Applications received after 13 January 2027 will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Certified copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26), attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD. A statement showing year-wise availability of APARs and grading, signed by the HOD/Secretary. If the APAR for a year in the last 5 years is not available, a "No Report Certificate" may be furnished, along with APARs of the preceding years. Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, and present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale. No objection certificate from the respective Port. Undertaking of the applicant that he will not withdraw his candidature, if selected by the Services Selection Committee. Administrative clearance of the concerned Port (Annexure II), certified by the Head of Department: particulars correct, no disciplinary/vigilance case pending or contemplated, integrity certified, no major/minor penalties in the last 10 years (or details), attested ACRs for 1.4.2021 to 31.3.2026 enclosed, and eligibility met. Vigilance report in the prescribed format (Annexure III), signed by the Head of Department and the Chief Vigilance Officer. Two passport size photographs. If any major or minor penalty has been imposed in the last 10 years, the disciplinary case leading to it with the necessary documents may be sent with the application.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: As per the Ministry's circular No.A-29018/4/2081/PE-I dated 11.8.2021, where an advance copy is received, the candidature will not be considered if the application is not received through proper channel from the Port within 15 days of the last date of receipt of applications. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will not be considered. A Port official who withdraws candidature after selection by the Services Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to Dy. HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years. Annexure III asks for service details, Annual Property Return status, positions held in the ten preceding years and any punishment, proceedings, complaints or allegations in the last 10 years. Contact printed on the notice: Phone 91-22-6656 4266, Email [email protected] , Website www.mumbaiport.gov.in .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice fills one post of Sr. Deputy Chief Medical Officer (Administration), which will be vacant with effect from 9 May 2027.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application on OAP is open from 30 November 2026 to 29 December 2026. The administrative Ports must forward the hard copies to MbPA on or before 13 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Sr. Deputy Chief Medical Officer (Administration) post?
faq.answer: Only eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities can apply, as the post is filled by absorption through composite method.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: An MBBS degree from a recognised university and a post graduate medical degree in the specified speciality from a recognised university. Annexure I also lists 10 years' post qualification experience in a hospital in the relevant field of specialisation.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an age limit?
faq.answer: Annexure I gives an upper age limit of 45 years for direct recruitment, but states that it will not apply in the case of absorption/deputation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the post?
faq.answer: The post is in the pay scale of Rs.80000-220000.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply on the Ministry's Online Application Portal (onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in), then submit the hard copy with documents to your administrative Port, which forwards it to MbPA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by merit by the Services Selection Committee, and the overall grading in the APARs should not be below "Very Good".

faq.question: Q9. What happens if a selected officer withdraws?
faq.answer: The official will be liable for debarment from future selection to Dy. HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years.

faq.question: Q10. What is the crucial date for eligibility?
faq.answer: The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria is 9 May 2027.
